topic: Asking for Help with the Gas Pump

script.title: AT THE GAS PUMP
script.story_hook: A tired driver needs help at the pump.
script.intro_zh: 一位疲憊的司機，在加油機前需要幫忙。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we get help at a gas pump. Listen for polite how-to questions.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們在加油站請人幫忙。留意有禮貌的求助問句。
script.outro: Full tank, happy driver. See you soon!
script.outro_zh: 油加滿了，司機也開心了。下次再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each pump phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀加油常用說法。
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged woman in her forties with a chin-length brown bob, wearing a beige trench coat, blue jeans and brown ankle boots, average build, looking tired
script.char_b_description: a teenage boy with short curly black hair, wearing a bright green station vest over a gray tee, dark pants and old sneakers, lean and quick

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, sorry! Is pump 4 broken?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ sɑɹi ɪz pʌmp fɔɹ ˈbroʊkən/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下！4號加油機壞了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look. Oh yeah, the screen is dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi lʊk oʊ jɛ ðə skɪn ɪz dɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 我看一下。哦對，螢幕是黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm new around here. Which pumps work?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm nu əˈɹaʊnd hɪɹ wɪtʃ pʌmps wɜɹk/
dialogue.zh: 我是外地來的。哪幾號機可以用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use seven or eight. Both are fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ˈsɛvɚ ɔɹ ˈeɪt boθ ɑɹ faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 用7號或8號，兩台都好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. My card didn't work at four though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt maɪ kɑɹd ˈdɪdnt wɜɹk æt fɔɹ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。可是我那張卡在4號刷不過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That reader crashed. Pay inside works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈɹidɚ kɹæʃt peɪ ɪnˈsaɪd wɜɹks/
dialogue.zh: 那台讀卡機當機了。請到室內付款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pay inside? Do I tell the cashier?
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪ ɪnˈsaɪd du aɪ tɛl ðə kæˈʃɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 室內付款？要跟櫃員說號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, give them the pump number first.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɡɪv ðɛm ðə pʌmp ˈnʌmbɚ fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 對，先告訴櫃員機台號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. And I choose the gas grade there?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ænd aɪ tʃuz ðə ɡæs ɡɹeɪd ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好。加油等級也在裡面選嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Regular is number 87. You need regular?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɛɡjəlɚ ɪz ˈnʌmbɚ ˈeɪtiˈsɛvən ju nid ˈɹɛɡjəlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一般油就是87。你要這個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I drive a small car. So yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪ dɹaɪv ə smɑl kɑɹ soʊ jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我開小客車。87應該對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'll walk over with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt aɪl wɔk ˈoʊvɚ wɪθ ju/
dialogue.zh: 那沒問題。我陪你過去一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're kind. What's that green button for?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ kaɪnd wʌts ðæt ɡɹin ˈbɑtn fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你人真好。那個綠色按鈕是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one? Diesel only. Don't press it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ˈdizəl ˈonli doʊnt pɹɛs ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那個是柴油專用。別按錯邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! The other side of pump 8 is diesel.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ði ˈʌðɚ saɪd ʌv pʌmp eɪt ɪz ˈdizəl/
dialogue.zh: 啊？8號另一邊是柴油用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You learned it fast. Ready to start?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lɜnd ɪt fæst ˈɹɛdi tə stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 你學得真快。可以開始了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. The screen woke up, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə skɪn woʊk ʌp aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 好的，機台終於開起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Prepaid or fill-up, which one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌpɹiˈpeɪd ɔɹ fɪl‿ʌp wɪtʃ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 選預付還是加滿？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Prepaid forty dollars, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌpɹiˈpeɪd ˈfɔɹti ˈdɑlɚz pliz/
dialogue.zh: 預付四十塊，麻煩你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem. Insert card, press start.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm ɪnˈsɜɹt kɑɹd pɹɛs stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。插卡，然後按綠色的開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Okay, it's beeping.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs oʊˈkeɪ ɪts ˈbipɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 插這裡嗎？好的，它在嗶了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now lift the nozzle, keep it straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɪft ðə nɑˈzɛl kip ɪt stɹeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 現在拿槍，握正，貼著油箱口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son always props it with the handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sʌn ˈɔlweɪz pɹɑps ɪt wɪθ ðə ˈhændəl/
dialogue.zh: 我兒子都是這樣：卡住扳機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Now both hands are free!
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt naʊ boʊ hændz ɑɹ fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，這樣兩手都自由了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm stuck now! Ha. How long, um, roughly?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm stʌk naʊ hɑ haʊ lɔŋ ˈɹʌfli/
dialogue.zh: 現在我走不了了！哈。大概要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three minutes for forty bucks, tops.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi ˈmɪnəts fɔɹ ˈfɔɹti bʌks tɑps/
dialogue.zh: 四十塊大概三分鐘就到頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool. Do I press stop when it jumps?
dialogue.phonetic: /kul du aɪ pɹɛs stɑp wɛn ɪt dʒʌmps/
dialogue.zh: 好。跳停了要按停止嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stops itself. Just hang the nozzle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑps ɪtˈsɛlf dʒʌst hæŋ ðə nɑˈzɛl/
dialogue.zh: 它會自己停。把槍掛回去就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. See? The cap went back on.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn si ðə kæp wɛnt bæk ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 好了。看，蓋子也蓋回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice. Want a receipt from the machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wɑnt ə ɹɪˈsit fɹʌm ðə məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 很好。要從機台列印收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. I need it for expenses.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz aɪ nid ɪt fɔɹ ɪkˈspɛnsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 要，我報銷要用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go. Warm from the printer.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ju ɡoʊ wɔɹm fɹʌm ðə ˈpɹɪntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 給您，熱騰騰的收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks! Oh no, foam on my window!
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks oʊ noʊ foʊm ɑn maɪ ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！噢不，玻璃上有泡沫！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, my cleaner bottle tipped over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi maɪ ˈklinɚ ˈbɑtl̩ tɪpt ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我的清潔劑瓶子倒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's fine! A wipe fixes everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪn ə waɪp fɪksɪz ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係！擦兩下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, take a cloth. On the house.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ teɪk ə klɔθ ɑn ðə haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 來，拿塊抹布。免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ ˈsɪɹəsli/
dialogue.zh: 你真的幫了大忙，我說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha. We're famous for coffee inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wɪɹ ˈfeɪməs fɔɹ ˈkɔfi ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我們店裡的咖啡很有名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee? Well, it is early morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi wɛl ɪt ɪz ˈɜɹli ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡？現在才上午啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bucks, and the mug is huge.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bʌks ænd ðə mʌɡ ɪz hjudʒ/
dialogue.zh: 兩塊一杯，杯子超大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small cup for me. My day is fixed.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑl kʌp fɔɹ mi maɪ deɪ ɪz fɪkst/
dialogue.zh: 我要小杯。我的一天得救啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glad to hear it. Mondays get busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæd tə hɪɹ ɪt ˈmʌndeɪz ɡɛt ˈbɪzi/
dialogue.zh: 很高興聽你這麼說。週一早上特別忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saw the long line by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ðə lɔŋ laɪn baɪ ðə dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛就看到門口排了長龍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tip: pump 7 stays the most reliable.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪp pʌmp sɛvɚ steɪz ðə moʊst ɹɪˈlaɪəbl̩/
dialogue.zh: 建議是：7號機最穩定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted. And eight is diesel, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd ænd eɪt ɪz ˈdizəl ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 記住。8號另一邊給柴油車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly right. You're a quick study.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɹaɪt jʊɹ ə kwɪk ˈstʌdi/
dialogue.zh: 完全正確！你學得真快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I keep this receipt for anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ kip ðɪs ɹɪˈsit fɔɹ ˈɛniθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這張收據要留著做什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Until month's end, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈtɪl mʊnθs ˈɛnd dʒʌst ɪn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 留到月底，以防有爭議。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One silly pump didn't beat me today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɪli pʌmp dɪdnt bit mi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一台糊塗加油機打不倒我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Safe travels, and enjoy coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ seɪf ˈtɹævl̩z ænd ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！一路順風，咖啡在裡面等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll grab it after I wipe the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɡɹæb ɪt ˈæftɚ aɪ waɪp ðə ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 我擦完玻璃就來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time. Pump seven is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊɹ taɪm pʌmp ˈsɛvɚ ɪz jʊɹz/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，7號機隨時為你留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Let me tip you, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt lɛt mi tɪp ju oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我給你小費，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need! Have a great commute.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ nid hæv ə ɡɹeɪt kəˈmjut/
dialogue.zh: 不用啦！祝你上班順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you again. What was your name?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju əˈɡɛn wʌt wʌz jʊɹ neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 再謝一次，你叫什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Marco! Ask for me if pumps act up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɑɹkoʊ æsk fɔɹ mi ɪf pʌmps ækt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 馬可！下次加油機再鬧脾氣就找我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Marco it is. You saved my Monday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɑɹkoʊ ɪt ɪz ju seɪvd maɪ ˈmʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就記下馬可了。你救了我的週一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my job, and honestly, fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ dʒɑb ænd ˈɑnəstli fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的工作，說真的也挺有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you next Monday, Marco. Bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju nɛkst ˈmʌndeɪ ˈmɑɹkoʊ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 下週一再見，馬可。拜拜！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye! Full tank, clean glass, good luck.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ fʊl tæŋk kliːn ɡlæs ɡʊd lʌk/
dialogue.zh: 拜拜！油滿、玻璃亮，一切順利！

script.youtube_title_en: "Pay Inside Works" — Asking for Help with the Gas Pump
script.youtube_description:
60句加油站聽力練習：加油機螢幕當機、卡片刷不過，該怎麼找人幫忙、把油加好？

這一集跟著一位剛搬來小鎮的司機，從4號壞機換到7號，學會室內付款、選油品等級、預付或加滿、柴油側的注意，還有灑到泡沫的小意外怎麼收場。

你會聽到：
- 機台當機、卡片讀不到的求助問句
- 加油等級、預付與加滿的說法
- 油槍、按扳機、跳停等實用動詞
- 收據、小費與閒聊的禮貌用語

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of gas station listening practice: a new-in-town driver meets a friendly attendant when pump 4 crashes, then learns to pay inside, pick a fuel grade, choose prepaid or fill-up, and dodge the diesel side.

You will hear how to ask for pump help, talk about card readers and receipts, handle the nozzle, and end with easy small talk. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.
